proposition: Running a PG is a game rigged against the owner until he installs RentOK, and then every obstacle that used to stop him just breaks.

board.style_line: Original pixel-art side-scrolling platformer, 16-bit era look, chunky 4-px pixels, flat saturated palette, hard black outlines, cream sky, parallax row of three-storey Indian PG buildings with rooftop water tanks, AC units and drying clothes, ground a row of blue #0038FF bricks, 9:16 vertical, razor-sharp, no blur.
board.negative_line: No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no HUD, no score counters, no Nintendo characters or assets, no green warp pipes, no mushrooms, no real brand marks, no photoreal, no motion blur, no watermark.

identity_anchors.owner: The Owner: a stout pixel-art man, 48 px tall, checked half-sleeve shirt in mustard and brown, grey trousers, thick black moustache, small round glasses, a big brass key-ring on his belt; always faces right.
identity_anchors.world: PG World: cream sky, parallax backdrop of Indian PG buildings, blue #0038FF brick ground, small floating blue-brick platforms; the level scrolls left-to-right.
identity_anchors.powerup: RentOK Power-Up: a glowing smartphone block, blue #0038FF body with a cyan #03FFF1 screen, hovering with a slow bob; once taken the Owner has a cyan #03FFF1 outline glow and carries a blue #0038FF phone-shaped blaster that fires short cyan bolts.
identity_anchors.flag: The Flag: a tall grey flagpole on a stepped blue-brick block, flying a blue #0038FF flag with a cyan #03FFF1 tick-shaped emblem.

hero_frame.description: The Owner mid-sprint in the air, cyan glow around his outline, blue phone-blaster raised and a cyan bolt leaving it; directly ahead the wallet enemy and the ledger tower are bursting into cyan tick-shaped confetti; further right, small in frame, the blue flag on its pole; behind him the crumpled gate and the swarm already dissolving. One frame says it: the same man, same level, now unstoppable, and the thing that changed is blue-and-cyan in his hand.

audio.music_bed: Continuous 8-bit chiptune loop laid under by code: bright and bouncy for beats 1-6 with a descending 'hit' sting each time the Owner is stopped, a two-second silence-then-rising arpeggio at the power-up (beat 7), then the same tune doubled in tempo and octave for beats 8-9, resolving on a held major chord under the brand close. Generated clip audio kept only for in-game SFX (footsteps, jump, coin, bump, collapse, zap).

beats.title: Level start
beats.feeling: Instant recognition: 'oh, it is a platformer' and a smile; the Owner is small, hopeful and about to have a bad day.
beats.framing: Full vertical game view. Owner stands centre-left on the blue brick ground; a PG building with a hand-painted-style board (blank, no letters) fills the background; a coin bobs above a floating platform at top-right. The level begins to scroll right as the Owner starts running.
beats.first_frame: Owner standing still, feet together, facing right, key-ring glinting; cream sky, PG buildings, blue brick ground, one floating platform top-right with a single gold coin above it. Nothing moves yet.
beats.impact: Static camera for 1 s, then a run-cycle starts and the whole world scrolls; chiptune loop kicks in on the first step. A cheerful start we are about to punish.

beats.title: Obstacle: tenant verification
beats.feeling: The first blocked door of the day; mild, familiar frustration.
beats.framing: Owner runs in from the left and hits a turnstile gate built of blank grey faceless ID-card tiles with a fat red padlock in the middle; he bumps it, bounces back two steps, tries again, bounces again. Gate rattles but never opens.
beats.first_frame: Owner in run pose at left third; gate of blank ID-card tiles with red padlock occupying the centre, ground continues behind it; a faceless tenant silhouette waits on the far side of the gate.
beats.impact: Two bumps timed to two 'thud' SFX and a descending sting; the code overlay label lands on the first bump and holds. Camera locked.

beats.title: Obstacle: collecting rent
beats.feeling: Chasing money that keeps stepping out of reach; comic, but the viewer who owns a PG winces.
beats.framing: A fat brown wallet enemy with tiny legs waddles left; a row of five gold coins floats above it. Owner jumps for the coins; the wallet snaps its mouth open and swallows them one by one, then waddles off right, faster than he can run.
beats.first_frame: Owner crouched to jump at left; wallet enemy centre with mouth closed; five gold coins in an arc above the wallet; blue bricks below.
beats.impact: Coin-vanish SFX in reverse (a 'gulp') for each swallowed coin; Owner lands empty-handed on the last gulp; label overlay lands on the first gulp. Camera pans slightly right following the wallet's escape.

beats.title: Obstacle: left without paying
beats.feeling: Too late, again; a tenant is gone and so is the money.
beats.framing: A tenant sprite with a suitcase sprints right and leaps onto a passing yellow-and-black auto-rickshaw; the auto drives off frame right in a dust puff. Owner arrives sliding to a stop at the empty spot; behind him a doorway of a PG room stands open and dark.
beats.first_frame: Tenant sprite mid-leap toward an auto-rickshaw at right edge; Owner far left, still running; open dark doorway in the building behind.
beats.impact: Auto horn SFX, tyre squeal, then two silent beats on the Owner alone; label overlay lands as the dust settles. Camera holds; the emptiness is the joke.

beats.title: Obstacle: no reconciliation
beats.feeling: Buried under paper; the month-end that never adds up.
beats.framing: A wobbling tower of paper registers, loose receipts and rubber-banded cash bundles, twice the Owner's height, tilts and collapses onto him. He is left with only his glasses and key-ring poking out of the pile.
beats.first_frame: Owner standing under the leaning tower of registers and receipts, arms raised as if to catch it; tower already tilting 15 degrees.
beats.impact: Collapse SFX like a bookshelf falling; label overlay slams in with the impact; camera shakes two frames.

beats.title: Obstacle: complaints, and game over
beats.feeling: Swarmed from all sides; the Owner is out of lives.
beats.framing: Owner climbs out of the paper pile straight into a swarm of red angry-face speech-bubble sprites pouring out of a dripping tap and a sparking ceiling fan on the building behind. They circle him; he spins, gets hit, does the classic knocked-back tumble and the screen desaturates to grey with the Owner slumped.
beats.first_frame: Owner half-emerged from the paper pile; three red speech-bubble sprites already inbound from a dripping tap top-left and a sparking fan top-right; more bubbles queued behind.
beats.impact: Buzzing swarm SFX, hit sting, then the music cuts to silence as the frame goes grey; label overlay lands on the first hit. The silence is the cliffhanger.

beats.title: Cheat code: install RentOK app
beats.feeling: The secret every gamer wanted: a code that changes the rules.
beats.framing: Grey freeze. A blue smartphone block with a cyan screen descends from the top of frame and hovers in front of the slumped Owner. He reaches up and touches it; a cyan flash washes the screen and colour returns, brighter than before. Owner rises with a cyan outline glow and the blue phone-blaster in hand.
beats.first_frame: Grey desaturated frame; slumped Owner at bottom centre; the blue #0038FF phone block with cyan #03FFF1 screen entering from top edge, small halo around it; the RentOK wordmark composited by code on the block's screen.
beats.impact: Silence, then a rising arpeggio as the block descends; the 'INSTALL / RENTOK APP' overlay types in above the block like a cheat entry; power-up chime on touch; cyan flash. Camera pushes in 10 percent on the touch.

beats.title: Power run
beats.feeling: Pure release; everything that stopped him now breaks on contact.
beats.framing: The level rewinds behind him in a blur and the same five obstacles line up ahead in order: ID-card gate, wallet enemy, auto-rickshaw with tenant, ledger tower, bubble swarm. Owner sprints and jumps through at double speed, firing short cyan bolts; each obstacle bursts into cyan tick-shaped confetti as he passes. The flag pole grows from small to full height at frame right by the end.
beats.first_frame: Owner at left in full sprint with cyan glow and blue blaster raised; the ID-card gate directly ahead, the other four obstacles receding in a line behind it; flag pole tiny at far right.
beats.impact: Music doubled in tempo; a zap plus a coin-jingle for each burst; the five tick overlays fire in sequence, one per obstacle, each landing exactly on its burst and stacking down the left edge. Camera tracks right with him at his speed.

beats.title: The flag
beats.feeling: Level complete; the small triumph a PG owner rarely gets to feel.
beats.framing: Owner leaps, grabs the top of the flagpole and slides down as the blue flag with its cyan tick rises to the top; blue and cyan pixel fireworks pop over the PG buildings behind.
beats.first_frame: Owner in mid-air with both hands on the pole near its top; flag at half-mast rising; first two fireworks just bursting in the sky.
beats.impact: Slide SFX plus level-clear fanfare; the Owner lands, turns to camera for the first time and gives a thumbs-up; hold 0.5 s. Camera locked on the pole.

beats.title: Brand close (code-composed)
beats.feeling: Clear, calm, one thing to do.
beats.framing: Flat blue #0038FF ground. Centre: the RentOK wordmark asset (Rent in white, Ok in cyan). Above it the two-line ask INSTALL / RENTOK APP in white; below it RENTOK.COM in cyan. Nothing else.
beats.first_frame: Blue field, wordmark centred, ask above, URL below, all already on screen.
beats.impact: Cut from the thumbs-up on a single chiptune chord that holds to the end; no animation except a one-frame cyan flash on the cut. Card holds 1.5 s.

label_verification.why: Names the gate on the Owner's first bump; pixel-font super, top third, white on a black pill.

label_rent.why: Lands on the first swallowed coin; same super style, top third.

label_left.why: Lands as the auto's dust settles on the empty spot.

label_recon.why: Slams in with the ledger collapse.

label_complaints.why: Lands on the first bubble hit, then greys out with the frame.

cheat_code.why: The cheat code itself, typed in letter by letter above the phone block, two stacked lines, white then cyan; this is the film's turn and the first time the product is named.

tick_kyc.why: Fires when the ID-card gate bursts; stacks down the left edge in cyan on black pills.

tick_autopay.why: Fires when the wallet enemy bursts.

tick_dues.why: Fires when the auto-rickshaw and tenant burst.

tick_dashboard.why: Fires when the ledger tower bursts.

tick_tickets.why: Fires when the bubble swarm bursts; five ticks now stacked as the flag comes into view.

close_card.why: Closing card over the wordmark on blue: the ask repeated once more, plus the URL, nothing else.

mandatory.customer_words: I want to make a video for RentOK.
mandatory.realisation: RentOK is the power-up (beat 7), the flag colours (beat 9) and the closing card (beat 10).

mandatory.customer_words: An original Mario-inspired game, rather than an exact reproduction of Nintendo's character, artwork, music or game assets.
mandatory.realisation: Original pixel platformer: moustached PG-owner sprite in a checked shirt, Indian PG buildings, blue-brick ground, auto-rickshaw, ledger towers; no pipes, mushrooms, named characters or Nintendo music; negative line forbids them in every prompt.

mandatory.customer_words: The player is basically a PG owner.
mandatory.realisation: The Owner identity anchor (key-ring, glasses, checked shirt) in front of a PG building from frame one (beat 1).
Beat 2: gate of blank ID-card tiles with a red padlock that will not open; burst by the blaster in beat 8 with the DIGITAL KYC tick.
Beat 3: wallet enemy that swallows the coins before the Owner can reach them; burst in beat 8 with the AUTOPAY tick.
Beat 4: tenant with suitcase escapes on an auto-rickshaw leaving a dark empty room; burst in beat 8 with the DUES TRACKED LIVE tick.
Beat 5: tower of paper registers and receipts collapses on the Owner; burst in beat 8 with the ONE DASHBOARD tick.
Beat 6: swarm of red speech-bubble sprites from a dripping tap and sparking fan knocks him out; burst in beat 8 with the COMPLAINT TICKETS tick.

mandatory.customer_words: The game also introduces a cheat code — install RentOK app.
mandatory.realisation: Beat 7: after the grey game-over, a blue phone block descends and the code-composed 'INSTALL / RENTOK APP' types in above it like a cheat entry.

mandatory.customer_words: Mario gets a gun sort of power/immunity.
mandatory.realisation: On touching the block the Owner gains a cyan outline glow (immunity) and a blue phone-shaped blaster firing cyan bolts (the 'gun sort of' power), used through beat 8.

mandatory.customer_words: It runs and kills all the obstacles and gets the flag.
mandatory.realisation: Beat 8: all five obstacles burst in order at double speed; beat 9: he grabs the pole and the RentOK-coloured flag rises.

mandatory.customer_words: Platforms: Instagram Reels / Facebook and YouTube Shorts.
mandatory.realisation: 9:16 vertical game view throughout; obstacle labels and ticks kept inside the safe zone away from platform UI.

mandatory.customer_words: Brand and product source: Official RentOK website, https://rentok.com.
mandatory.realisation: Wordmark asset rentok_wordmark used as supplied (Rent white, Ok cyan, blue #0038FF ground) on the power-up screen (beat 7) and the closing card (beat 10); brand blue and cyan carry the flag and all power-up effects; URL RENTOK.COM on the card.

mandatory.customer_words: exact_text_strings: INSTALL, RENTOK APP, TENANT VERIFICATION, COLLECTING RENT, LEFT WITHOUT PAYING, NO RECONCILIATION, COMPLAINTS, the five tick features, RENTOK.COM
mandatory.realisation: Every supplied string is placed exactly once per listing in the copy deck, composed by code, never generated in frame.

brand_timeline.in_context: RentOK enters as the game's power-up: the wordmark on the phone block's screen at 18 s, named by the cheat-code overlay at 18.6 s; brand blue and cyan then own every effect from 21 s to the flag at 26.5 s and the card at 28.5 s. Before 18 s the blue brick ground quietly carries brand blue without naming the brand.

last_frame: Closing card: blue #0038FF field, RentOK wordmark centred (Rent white, Ok cyan), INSTALL / RENTOK APP above in white, RENTOK.COM below in cyan; held to 30 s.
